_comment: The rules of single tyres (#289), read by the server (Domain TyrePlacesContractTests, over TyrePlaces and TyreHistory) and by the device (frontend TyrePlaces.unit, over src/tyres/tyrePlaces.ts), so a change made offline shows as the server will make it. Ids are short names each side maps to ids of its own; 'new' is the installation an operation creates. A case gives the sets ('brokenUpOn' set for a broken-up one), the live installations, the tyres and their places (a place's id names it in 'editPlace' and 'moving'), then one 'op': 'breakUp', 'swap' ('corners' by tyre, or null: as before; a tyre left out has none), 'positions', 'move' (a swap moved by its line's day), 'edit' (an installation's days), 'add' (an installation typed in History), 'addPlace', 'editPlace' or 'check' ('moving' lists the places a check is about, 'restoring' when they come back from the trash). 'expectPlaces' lists the live places after it by tyre, then first day; 'error' is the refusal with its key and args. 'placeIds' pins the ids a change works out for the places it makes by itself (TyreIds.PlaceOf: the two ids' hex digits exclusive-or'd pairwise).

cases.name: a break-up gives each tyre the set's history: its corner now, front or rear where the pairs were recorded, none where they were not
a break-up with Not sure gives that tyre no corner anywhere
a break-up needs a label on every tyre
a break-up gives each tyre its own label, without case
a break-up puts two tyres at one corner only with Not sure
a set broken up stays broken up
a swap off a broken-up set ends its tyres' places with its installation
a swap onto a broken-up set places each tyre at the corner given, one left out without a corner
a swap from papers onto a broken-up set gives each tyre the corner it had before
a swap meeting the set's installation joins it when every tyre keeps its corner
a swap meeting the set's installation stays apart when a tyre changes corner
a change of positions splits the installation and each tyre's place
a change of positions on the installation's first day changes the corners in place
a change of positions to the corners they have changes nothing
a swap moved by its line's day takes the places at its ends along
an installation edited takes the places at its ends along
an installation edited so a tyre's own place falls outside it is refused
an installation added places each tyre at the corner it had before, none before the first
a tyre's time on the car changed alone is that tyre's
a tyre's time on the car outside its set's installations is refused, naming the set on the car then
a tyre is on the car once at a time
one tyre at an exact corner
at most two tyres at the front, a side not recorded counting toward it
at most two tyres at the rear
a fifth tyre on the car is refused
a retired tyre is on the car only until it was retired
a restore that puts two tyres at one corner is refused, naming the other tyre
